name: Corvid’s Cunning, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

Mass corvid’s cunning works like corvid’s cunning, except that it affects multiple creatures.
